senses.sense_definition: A stone coffin or burial chamber made of slabs placed on edge and covered with a flat stone.

examples.text: Archaeologists discovered a prehistoric <w>cist</w> containing human remains and several small clay vessels.
The ancient burial site featured a stone <w>cist</w> built directly into the side of the rocky cliff.

senses.sense_definition: A small container used for carrying sacred objects during religious festivals in Ancient Greece.

examples.text: During the procession, the priest carried a decorated <w>cist</w> filled with ritual items for the ceremony.
Historical records describe the sacred <w>cist</w> as a vital part of the religious offerings in the festival.
